basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Seattle, WA, with a newfound passion for epic fantasy series. I enjoy immersing myself in fictional worlds to unwind from my daily routine. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings exploring different subreddits or joining online forums related to my interests. I'm usually online from 7 PM to midnight PST on weekdays, and more sporadically on weekends. Besides reading, I enjoy listening to podcasts and experimenting with dice making.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: While I don't have a formal education in literature, I've developed a deep appreciation for fantasy novels through personal exploration. I often read reviews and watch YouTube discussions to enhance my understanding. My knowledge of topics like strabismus comes from personal experience and conducting my research online.
